description: m6-01 seed case 5/5 (07 section 7.11): exercises the REAL retry-then-fallback logic in dispatch.ts/router.ts, not a mock of it. harness.preferred is 'codex' -- src/adapters/fixture.ts wires the eval CLI's codex slot to a fixed always-transport-failure instance (raw.error matches result-mapper.ts's TRANSPORT_SIGNAL_RE) -- so dispatch.ts calls adapter.start() twice (MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_HARNESS), both transport-classified, then falls back to the first probe-passing entry in harness.fallback: 'gemini', wired to a fixed always-accepted instance. Three real adapter.start() calls total (codex x2, gemini x1); the case's own acceptance[].verify then runs for real against the real worktree once the fallback succeeds.

prompt.objective: Exercise two consecutive transport failures on the preferred harness followed by a successful fallback.

acceptance.statement: The fallback harness's real acceptance check passes.
